name: Richmond County, GA
findings: Richmond County has 629 nonprofit organizations. 226 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 176 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Richmond County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Richmond County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 120 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Richmond County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few economic development organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 economic development organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through economic development groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 78 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 78 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
